Title: Lab Reports PDF upload accepts CSV/XLS file types despite PDF-only label
Preconditions: User logged in as team40 and on Lab Reports form (New or existing record) with Upload Report section visible
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open https://team40.qaaerp.com 2. Login with ID team40 and password vASPFtSh4d 3. Navigate to Lab Reports 4. Open a record (or click New if list is empty) 5. Scroll to Upload Report section 6. In Report PDF / PDF File upload control, upload a .csv or .xls file (example: invalid-upload.csv)
Expected Result: System should reject non-PDF/non-image files and show validation error for disallowed type.
Actual Result: Application accepts invalid-upload.csv in Report PDF field (UI shows filename in uploaded state), indicating non-PDF file type is allowed. DOM inspection shows PDF upload input configured with accept='*'.
Evidence: Screenshot: postqode-screenshots/screenshot-1783776635120.png; UI snapshot shows Report PDF value 'invalid-upload.csv'; DOM evidence from live page: input[type=file] for PDF has accept='*'.
